   13 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   14  *
   15  * Created:		H5WB.c
   16  *			Jun 26 2007
   17  *			Quincey Koziol
   18  *
   19  * Purpose:		Implements the "wrapped buffer" code for wrapping
   20  *                      an existing [statically sized] buffer, in order to
   21  *                      avoid lots of memory allocation calls.
   22  *
   23  *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   24  */
   25 
   26 /****************/
   27 /* Module Setup */
   28 /****************/
   29 
   30 /***********/
   31 /* Headers */
   32 /***********/
   33 #include "H5private.h"   /* Generic Functions			*/
   34 #include "H5Eprivate.h"  /* Error handling		  	*/
   35 #include "H5FLprivate.h" /* Free Lists                           */
   36 #include "H5WBprivate.h" /* Wrapped Buffers                      */
   37 
   38 /****************/
   39 /* Local Macros */
   40 /****************/
   41 
   42 /******************/
   43 /* Local Typedefs */
   44 /******************/
   45 
   46 /********************/
   47 /* Package Typedefs */
   48 /********************/
   49 
   50 /* Typedef for buffer wrapper */
   51 struct H5WB_t {
   52     void  *wrapped_buf;  /* Pointer to wrapped buffer */
   53     size_t wrapped_size; /* Size of wrapped buffer */
   54     void  *actual_buf;   /* Pointer to actual buffer */
   55     size_t actual_size;  /* Size of actual buffer used */
   56     size_t alloc_size;   /* Size of actual buffer allocated */
   57 };
   58 
   59 /********************/
   60 /* Local Prototypes */
   61 /********************/
   62 
   63 /*********************/
   64 /* Package Variables */
   65 /*********************/
   66 
   67 /*****************************/
   68 /* Library Private Variables */
   69 /*****************************/
   70 
   71 /*******************/
   72 /* Local Variables */
   73 /*******************/
   74 
   75 /* Declare a free list to manage the H5WB_t struct */
   76 H5FL_DEFINE_STATIC(H5WB_t);
   77 
   78 /* Declare a free list to manage the extra buffer information */
   79 H5FL_BLK_DEFINE_STATIC(extra_buf);
   80 
   81 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   82  * Function:	H5WB_wrap
   83  *
   84  * Purpose:	Wraps an existing [possibly static] buffer
   85  *
   86  * Return:	Pointer to buffer wrapper info on success
   87  *              NULL on failure
   88  *
   89  * Programmer:	Quincey Koziol
   90  *		Jun 26 2007
   91  *
   92  *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   93  */
   94 H5WB_t *
   95 H5WB_wrap(void *buf, size_t buf_size)
   96 {
   97     H5WB_t *wb = NULL; /* Wrapped buffer info */
   98     H5WB_t *ret_value; /* Return value */
   99 
  100     FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI(NULL)
  101 
  102     /*
  103      * Check arguments.
  104      */
  105     HDassert(buf);
  106     HDassert(buf_size);
  107 
  108     /* Create wrapped buffer info */
  109     if (NULL == (wb = H5FL_MALLOC(H5WB_t)))
  110         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed for wrapped buffer info")
  111 
  112     /* Wrap buffer given */
  113     wb->wrapped_buf  = buf;
  114     wb->wrapped_size = buf_size;
  115 
  116     /* No actual buffer yet */
  117     wb->actual_buf  = NULL;
  118     wb->actual_size = 0;
  119     wb->alloc_size  = 0;
  120 
  121     /* Set the return value */
  122     ret_value = wb;
  123 
  124 done:
  125     /* Release resources on error */
  126     if (!ret_value && wb)
  127         wb = H5FL_FREE(H5WB_t, wb);
  128 
  129     FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
  130 } /* end H5WB_wrap() */
  131 
  132 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
  133  * Function:	H5WB_actual
  134  *
  135  * Purpose:	Get the pointer to an "actual" buffer, of at least a certain
  136  *              size.
  137  *
  138  * Return:	Pointer to buffer pointer on success
  139  *              NULL on failure
  140  *
  141  * Programmer:	Quincey Koziol
  142  *		Jun 26 2007
  143  *
  144  *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
  145  */
  146 void *
  147 H5WB_actual(H5WB_t *wb, size_t need)
  148 {
  149     void *ret_value; /* Return value */
  150 
  151     FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI(NULL)
  152 
  153     /*
  154      * Check arguments.
  155      */
  156     HDassert(wb);
  157     HDassert(wb->wrapped_buf);
  158 
  159     /* Check for previously allocated buffer */
  160     if (wb->actual_buf && wb->actual_buf != wb->wrapped_buf) {
  161         /* Sanity check */
  162         HDassert(wb->actual_size > wb->wrapped_size);
  163 
  164         /* Check if we can re-use existing buffer */
  165         if (need <= wb->alloc_size)
  166             HGOTO_DONE(wb->actual_buf)
  167         /* Can't re-use existing buffer, free it and proceed */
  168         else
  169             wb->actual_buf = H5FL_BLK_FREE(extra_buf, wb->actual_buf);
  170     } /* end if */
  171 
  172     /* Check if size needed can be fulfilled with wrapped buffer */
  173     if (need > wb->wrapped_size) {
  174         /* Need to allocate new buffer */
  175         if (NULL == (wb->actual_buf = H5FL_BLK_MALLOC(extra_buf, need)))
  176             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
  177 
  178         /* Remember size of buffer allocated */
  179         wb->alloc_size = need;
  180     } /* end if */
  181     else {
  182         /* Don't have to allocate a new buffer, use the wrapped one */
  183         wb->actual_buf = wb->wrapped_buf;
  184         wb->alloc_size = 0;
  185     } /* end else */
  186 
  187     /* Set the return value */
  188     ret_value = wb->actual_buf;
  189 
  190 done:
  191     /* Remember size of buffer used, if we were successful */
  192     if (ret_value)
  193         wb->actual_size = need;
  194 
  195     FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
  196 } /* end H5WB_actual() */
  197 
  198 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
  199  * Function:	H5WB_actual_clear
  200  *
  201  * Purpose:	Get the pointer to an "actual" buffer, of at least a certain
  202  *              size.  Also, clear actual buffer to zeros.
  203  *
  204  * Return:	Pointer to buffer pointer on success
  205  *              NULL on failure
  206  *
  207  * Programmer:	Quincey Koziol
  208  *		Jun 26 2007
  209  *
  210  *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
  211  */
  212 void *
  213 H5WB_actual_clear(H5WB_t *wb, size_t need)
  214 {
  215     void *ret_value; /* Return value */
  216 
  217     FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI(NULL)
  218 
  219     /*
  220      * Check arguments.
  221      */
  222     HDassert(wb);
  223     HDassert(wb->wrapped_buf);
  224 
  225     /* Get a pointer to an actual buffer */
  226     if (NULL == (ret_value = H5WB_actual(wb, need)))
  227         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
  228 
  229     /* Clear the buffer */
  230     HDmemset(ret_value, 0, need);
  231 
  232 done:
  233     FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
  234 } /* end H5WB_actual_clear() */
  235 
  236 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
  237  * Function:	H5WB_unwrap
  238  *
  239  * Purpose:	"unwrap" a wrapped buffer, releasing all resources used
  240  *
  241  * Return:	SUCCEED/FAIL
  242  *
  243  * Programmer:	Quincey Koziol
  244  *		Jun 26 2007
  245  *
  246  *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
  247  */
  248 herr_t
  249 H5WB_unwrap(H5WB_t *wb)
  250 {
  251     FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI_NOINIT_NOERR
  252 
  253     /*
  254      * Check arguments.
  255      */
  256     HDassert(wb);
  257     HDassert(wb->wrapped_buf);
  258 
  259     /* Release any extra buffers allocated */

   18 #include "H5Zmodule.h" /* This source code file is part of the H5Z module */
   19 
   20 #include "H5private.h"   /* Generic Functions			*/
   21 #include "H5Eprivate.h"  /* Error handling		  	*/
   22 #include "H5MMprivate.h" /* Memory management			*/
   23 #include "H5Zpkg.h"      /* Data filters				*/

   26 
   27 #if defined(H5_HAVE_ZLIB_H) && !defined(H5_ZLIB_HEADER)
   28 #define H5_ZLIB_HEADER "zlib.h"
   29 #endif

   32 #endif

   34 /* Local function prototypes */
   35 static size_t H5Z__filter_deflate(unsigned flags, size_t cd_nelmts, const unsigned cd_values[], size_t nbytes,

   38 /* This message derives from H5Z */
   39 const H5Z_class2_t H5Z_DEFLATE[1] = {{
   40     H5Z_CLASS_T_VERS,    /* H5Z_class_t version */
   41     H5Z_FILTER_DEFLATE,  /* Filter id number		*/
   42     1,                   /* encoder_present flag (set to true) */
   43     1,                   /* decoder_present flag (set to true) */
   44     "deflate",           /* Filter name for debugging	*/
   45     NULL,                /* The "can apply" callback     */
   46     NULL,                /* The "set local" callback     */
   47     H5Z__filter_deflate, /* The actual filter function	*/
   48 }};
   49 
   50 #define H5Z_DEFLATE_SIZE_ADJUST(s) (HDceil(((double)(s)) * 1.001) + 12)
   51 
   52 /*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   53  * Function:	H5Z__filter_deflate
   54  *
   55  * Purpose:	Implement an I/O filter around the 'deflate' algorithm in
   56  *              libz
   57  *
   58  * Return:	Success: Size of buffer filtered
   59  *		Failure: 0
   60  *
   61  * Programmer:	Robb Matzke
   62  *              Thursday, April 16, 1998
   63  *
   64  *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
   65  */
   66 static size_t
   67 H5Z__filter_deflate(unsigned flags, size_t cd_nelmts, const unsigned cd_values[], size_t nbytes,
   68                     size_t *buf_size, void **buf)
   69 {
   70     void  *outbuf = NULL; /* Pointer to new buffer */
   71     int    status;        /* Status from zlib operation */
   72     size_t ret_value = 0; /* Return value */
   73 
   74     FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   75 
   76     /* Sanity check */
   77     HDassert(*buf_size > 0);
   78     HDassert(buf);
   79     HDassert(*buf);
   80 
   81     /* Check arguments */
   82     if (cd_nelmts != 1 || cd_values[0] > 9)
   83         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ARGS, H5E_BADVALUE, 0, "invalid deflate aggression level")
   84 
   85     if (flags & H5Z_FLAG_REVERSE) {
   86         /* Input; uncompress */
   87         z_stream z_strm;             /* zlib parameters */
   88         size_t   nalloc = *buf_size; /* Number of bytes for output (compressed) buffer */
   89 
   90         /* Allocate space for the compressed buffer */
   91         if (NULL == (outbuf = H5MM_malloc(nalloc)))
   92             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, 0, "memory allocation failed for deflate uncompression")
   93 
   94         /* Set the uncompression parameters */
   95         HDmemset(&z_strm, 0, sizeof(z_strm));
   96         z_strm.next_in = (Bytef *)*buf;
   97         H5_CHECKED_ASSIGN(z_strm.avail_in, unsigned, nbytes, size_t);
   98         z_strm.next_out = (Bytef *)outbuf;
   99         H5_CHECKED_ASSIGN(z_strm.avail_out, unsigned, nalloc, size_t);
  100 
  101         /* Initialize the uncompression routines */
  102         if (Z_OK != inflateInit(&z_strm))
  103             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_PLINE, H5E_CANTINIT, 0, "inflateInit() failed")
  104 
  105         /* Loop to uncompress the buffer */
  106         do {
  107             /* Uncompress some data */
  108             status = inflate(&z_strm, Z_SYNC_FLUSH);
  109 
  110             /* Check if we are done uncompressing data */
  111             if (Z_STREAM_END == status)
  112                 break; /*done*/
  113 
  114             /* Check for error */
  115             if (Z_OK != status) {
  116                 (void)inflateEnd(&z_strm);
  117                 HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_PLINE, H5E_CANTINIT, 0, "inflate() failed")
  118             }
  119             else {
  120                 /* If we're not done and just ran out of buffer space, get more */
  121                 if (0 == z_strm.avail_out) {
  122                     void *new_outbuf; /* Pointer to new output buffer */
  123 
  124                     /* Allocate a buffer twice as big */
  125                     nalloc *= 2;
  126                     if (NULL == (new_outbuf = H5MM_realloc(outbuf, nalloc))) {
  127                         (void)inflateEnd(&z_strm);
  128                         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, 0,
  129                                     "memory allocation failed for deflate uncompression")
  130                     } /* end if */
  131                     outbuf = new_outbuf;
  132 
  133                     /* Update pointers to buffer for next set of uncompressed data */
  134                     z_strm.next_out  = (unsigned char *)outbuf + z_strm.total_out;
  135                     z_strm.avail_out = (uInt)(nalloc - z_strm.total_out);
  136                 } /* end if */
  137             }     /* end else */
  138         } while (status == Z_OK);
  139 
  140         /* Free the input buffer */
  141         H5MM_xfree(*buf);
  142 
  143         /* Set return values */
  144         *buf      = outbuf;
  145         outbuf    = NULL;
  146         *buf_size = nalloc;
  147         ret_value = z_strm.total_out;
  148 
  149         /* Finish uncompressing the stream */
  150         (void)inflateEnd(&z_strm);
  151     } /* end if */
  152     else {
  153         /*
  154          * Output; compress but fail if the result would be larger than the
  155          * input.  The library doesn't provide in-place compression, so we
  156          * must allocate a separate buffer for the result.
  157          */
  158         const Bytef *z_src = (const Bytef *)(*buf);
  159         Bytef       *z_dst; /*destination buffer		*/
  160         uLongf       z_dst_nbytes = (uLongf)H5Z_DEFLATE_SIZE_ADJUST(nbytes);
  161         uLong        z_src_nbytes = (uLong)nbytes;
  162         int          aggression; /* Compression aggression setting */
  163 
  164         /* Set the compression aggression level */
  165         H5_CHECKED_ASSIGN(aggression, int, cd_values[0], unsigned);
  166 
  167         /* Allocate output (compressed) buffer */
  168         if (NULL == (outbuf = H5MM_malloc(z_dst_nbytes)))
  169             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, 0, "unable to allocate deflate destination buffer")
  170         z_dst = (Bytef *)outbuf;
  171 
  172         /* Perform compression from the source to the destination buffer */
  173         status = compress2(z_dst, &z_dst_nbytes, z_src, z_src_nbytes, aggression);
  174 
  175         /* Check for various zlib errors */
  176         if (Z_BUF_ERROR == status)
  177             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_PLINE, H5E_CANTINIT, 0, "overflow")
  178         else if (Z_MEM_ERROR == status)
  179             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_PLINE, H5E_CANTINIT, 0, "deflate memory error")
  180         else if (Z_OK != status)
  181             HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_PLINE, H5E_CANTINIT, 0, "other deflate error")
  182         /* Successfully uncompressed the buffer */
  183         else {
  184             /* Free the input buffer */
  185             H5MM_xfree(*buf);
  186 
  187             /* Set return values */
  188             *buf      = outbuf;
  189             outbuf    = NULL;
  190             *buf_size = nbytes;
  191             ret_value = z_dst_nbytes;
  192         } /* end else */
  193     }     /* end else */
  194 
  195 done:
  196     if (outbuf)
  197         H5MM_xfree(outbuf);
  198     FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
  199 }
  200 #endif /* H5_HAVE_FILTER_DEFLATE */
